categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Baolijia Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of water-based acrylic latex. The company's main product categories include architectural emulsions, waterproofing emulsions, industrial paint emulsions, textile emulsions, packaging emulsions, and various functional acrylic latex products along with additives. These products serve as raw materials for coatings and are widely applied across building coatings, waterproofing materials, textile processing, industrial applications, packaging materials, wood coatings, and metal coatings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs emulsion polymerization technology as its core manufacturing method, where monomers are dispersed in water under the action of emulsifiers and mechanical stirring to form polymer latex. Core technologies include core-shell structured latex particle technology, multi-stage deodorization technology for latex, and high solid content latex synthesis technology. The company operates modern research facilities equipped with advanced analytical instruments including GC, FTIR, DSC, GPC, HPLC, and particle size analyzers for quality control and product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major international and domestic paint manufacturers including Nippon Paint, Sherwin-Williams (through Carpoly), Three Trees Coatings, Oriental Yuhong Waterproofing, and Akzo Nobel. Primary end markets include building coatings (approximately 74% of downstream consumption), waterproofing materials, textile processing, industrial coatings, packaging materials, and emerging applications in adhesives and protective films. The company also serves customers in the lithium battery, printing, and packaging industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates five major production bases strategically located across China: Shanghai (East China), Anhui Mingguang (East China), Guangdong Foshan (South China), Shandong Yantai (North China), and Sichuan Deyang (Southwest China). A sixth production base is under construction in Hubei Yingcheng (Central China). The company has established distribution networks covering 31 provinces and municipalities in China, with growing international presence including operations in Malaysia and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily acrylic acid esters and styrene monomers) from upstream chemical suppliers and manufactures water-based acrylic latex products that are sold to downstream paint manufacturers, waterproofing material producers, textile processors, and packaging companies. The company also operates supply chain subsidiaries for logistics and material distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation as a strategic driver, positioning itself as a technology-focused enterprise. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-performance functional latex products, low-formaldehyde and formaldehyde-free textile emulsions, environmentally-friendly latex with low VOC and low odor characteristics, bio-based latex products, and specialized applications in lithium battery adhesive tapes and protective films. The company aims to develop products meeting international environmental standards such as EU Blue Angel certification and to expand into emerging application fields.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of water-based acrylic latex products to major paint manufacturers and industrial customers, supplemented by sales through regional distributors and agents. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of the goods, typically upon customer signature confirmation for domestic sales or when goods pass the ship's rail for export sales. The company operates a mixed sales model combining direct sales to strategic customers with distributor networks for broader market coverage.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic water-based acrylic latex manufacturer and the first listed company in this sector in China. It competes with multinational corporations including BASF and Dow Chemical, which focus on high-end products, and numerous domestic private enterprises. The company maintains competitive advantages through advanced technology, extensive production capacity, established customer relationships with major paint manufacturers, and comprehensive geographic distribution. The industry is consolidating with leading players gaining market share as smaller producers exit.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of 2.151 billion yuan, representing a 5.23% decline from 2023's 2.269 billion yuan, primarily due to raw material price fluctuations and intensified industry competition. The company reported a net loss of 149.67 million yuan in 2024 compared to a loss of 31.30 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 2.502 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced challenging market conditions in recent years but maintains substantial production capacity and financial resources for continued operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced technology platforms enabling customized, high-performance latex solutions tailored to specific customer requirements. Key value propositions include superior product quality with over 99% first-pass rate, comprehensive technical support and 24-hour service capabilities, environmentally-friendly formulations meeting stringent environmental standards, and reliable supply capacity backed by geographically distributed production bases. The company emphasizes innovation in emerging applications such as lithium battery adhesives and protective films, positioning itself as a technology leader rather than a commodity supplier.
